free_parameters.identification_labels_note: offer_curve_by_group is labelled 'residual' here -- the builder default -- and that is CORRECT for this run and a REAL CHANGE from keeper 4. Keeper 4 carried the identity 1.0 on every band and its committed ledger labelled the entry 'measured-physical'; this run carries 0.93, a value set against the price level through the rules 1/13 authorized channel, so the predecessor's label is deliberately NOT carried forward. offer_curve_smoothing (value unchanged from keeper 4) keeps the predecessor's label; the build_dof_ledger-vs-committed discrepancy on that entry is unresolved and remains SPP-50 R-3. DECLARED-VS-ACTUAL, reported as a miss: PRECOMMIT-spp-52a section 1(e) predicted the ledger would go '3 entries / 1 residual -> 4 entries / 2 residual'. n_residual 1 -> 2 is right; n_entries is WRONG and stays at 3, because the ledger schema counts offer_curve_by_group as ONE entry carrying a dict of scalars, so arming the channel RE-CHARACTERISES an existing entry instead of adding a new one.

governance.authorized_price_tuning_declared: DECLARED AND IN USE. This run tunes SPP's fossil offer curve DOWN 7 % on the price level through the rule 1 [R-STRUCT] / rule 13 [R-MEASURED] authorized channel (owner amendment 2026-09-05), on the owner's explicit instruction: 'first just tune the offer curve down by 7% across all fossil and launch an LP that runs that.' Every condition of the carve-out is met and each is checkable against this run's own run_config.json: (a) the four offer_curve_by_group bands ONLY -- committed/econ_low/econ_high/peak all 0.93 on the ten registered fossil classes SPP dispatches, with NO phys_* field, NO econ_low_share, NO pct_peaking and no adder/offset/haircut/proxy touched (verified: CT_PEAKER keeps econ_low_share 0.526 / pct_peaking 7.0, COAL_PRB 0.55, ST_GAS 0.5 / 15.0, and the three *_INTERMEDIATE curves keep their peak 2.25 / 3.0 / 2.2); (b) ONE config across EVERY scored year -- a single scalar 0.93, no per-year value; (c) set EX ANTE and declared in the PRECOMMIT before the solve, and NEVER swept -- no other multiplier was solved, scored or compared, and the declared value was not revised after its result was seen; (d) merit-order movement across classes is an intended effect; (e) declared here and carried as a ledgered free parameter, identification 'residual' sourced to the ruling. ST_CHP is excluded because it has no registered base curve in SPP's resolved offer_curve_by_group and including it fails the launch with KeyError: 'econ_low_share'.
governance.attested_by: SPP-52a (2026-09-09): SPP keeper 4's recipe (2026-09-09-spp-51c-oversupply-curtailment, which carries the oversupply curtailment allocation and the repaired GMT->fixed-CST actual-LMP clock) plus ONE change, the authorized offer-curve level above. ONE --year 2023 2024 2025 invocation, years sequential (rules 12/16). MEASURED EFFECT, graded against the PRECOMMIT: the load-weighted level falls -6.00 / -5.91 / -6.03 % (declared band 5.0-8.0 %, PASS, and near-perfectly uniform across years, which independently confirms the price-family lane's finding that a uniform quadruple is a LEVEL lever and not a shape lever); C3a +7.80/+5.64/+10.28 -> +1.34/-0.60/+3.63 %, inside +-10 % in all three years; C3b 0.1836/0.1894/0.2043 -> 0.1647/0.1769/0.1755, improving in every year with 2025 clearing <=0.20. REPORTED AGAINST THIS LANE'S OWN INTEREST, both pre-registered: the determination does NOT change -- C3c is pinned at 0/4/2 h against 42/59/68 (SPP has no scarcity mechanism of any kind, SPP-55's object) and the 2024 ST_GAS C1 row is the Harrington fuel-vintage object (SPP-46 R-4) that no offer multiplier reaches. A passing C3a is not a calibrated ISO. The curtailment mechanism is unaffected: the wind identity is unchanged to five decimals (1.10392/1.10434/1.10489) and the negative-hour count is 229/214/167 against keeper 4's 229/214/159. NOT a structural claim: this moves a level and nothing else, and it does not re-open the price-family lane's G-2 steepening refusal. Rule 22: 2023-2025 only; SPP holds no holdout marker and none is spent.

disclosures.note: SPP-52a disclosures -- reported, not patched (rules 1 / 13 / 14). Inherits keeper 4's.
disclosures.this_is_a_level_lever_only: The level move is -6.00 / -5.91 / -6.03 % -- flat to 0.12 pp across three years. That uniformity is the signature of a LEVEL lever, exactly what the price-family lane measured and refused on its G-2 steepening gate. Nothing here rotates the stack, and this run must not be read as overturning that finding.
disclosures.gates_that_still_fail: C1 on the 2024 ST_GAS row and C3c in all three years. Neither is reachable by an offer multiplier. The determination is NOT-YET and this run does not change it.
disclosures.declared_prediction_that_missed: PRECOMMIT section 1(e) said the DOF ledger would go '3 entries / 1 residual -> 4 entries / 2 residual'. n_residual 1 -> 2 is right; the ENTRY COUNT prediction was WRONG and stays at 3, because the schema counts offer_curve_by_group as one entry carrying a dict. Also, section 3's P-2 point predictions (+0.3 / -1.7 / +2.6 %) were each about 1 pp low because the realised level move is 6 %, not the assumed 7 %; the band claim (inside +-10 % in all three years) holds.
disclosures.no_screen_was_run: Rule 29 [R-SCREEN]: the owner asked for the full LP directly, so no one-year screen was spent and none is claimed. The pre-solve arithmetic in the PRECOMMIT section 3 is the phase-0 substitute.
